verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers search/recall APIs (hybrid search across memories and document chunks, memory graph traversal, and always-ready user profiles) that could be composed into a context block, and quickstart docs describe wiring retrieval into a chat harness. However, there is no explicit single-call API returning a token-budgeted, prompt-ready assembled context block — retrieval is split across three separate mechanisms (document search, graph traversal, profile) that the developer must combine themselves. Missing for 10: a documented single-call endpoint/parameter for token-budget control and automatic assembly of a ready-to-inject prompt block, plus independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific capability.
